why_this_file_exists: SM-AI-II had NO floors file, so every exam-scope task defaulted to a floor of 8. PROMPT-148 s2 retired 87 Opus-confirmed groups (261 rows), taking the live secure pool from 352 to 265 per language. The floors here are what the bank holds after that retirement.
the_rule: floor = the live, approved, SECURE row count for the task, counted per language and taken at the MINIMUM -- the same number verify-cert's s8 check compares a floor against. Derived from the BANK and not from a saturation census: the Scrum family has zero `task_sources` rows, so `propose-task-floors` correctly refuses. Written by `apply-task-floors.mjs --from-held`.
_what_this_floor_does_not_mean: It is NOT a statement that the task cannot hold more. Nothing has been generated for SM-AI-II, so every task could be refilled by authoring or by a grounded path once the family is mapped. The floor records what is served today so a real shortfall is visible against it.
